notes: PAP reference G53/3112. Whole vacant studio on rue Caponiere in central Caen, on the second floor of a three-storey 1997 residence. The complete advert describes a recently renovated south-east-facing apartment with an equipped kitchen, electric individual heating and hot water, roller shutters and intercom. The property is explicitly free today; its former 16-year tenancy and last rent are historical only. DPE C, annual coproperty charges of EUR 450 and annual property tax of EUR 750 are disclosed. A parking place is offered separately for EUR 13,000, so it is not included in the apartment's EUR 107,800 sale price. The live advert contains no current tenant, lease, occupied-sale or delayed-vacancy wording. PAP exposed 12 property photos and a publication date of 23 September 2026. No elevator is retained because the advert describes the second floor of a three-storey residence without mentioning a lift.
